message.content:
To retrieve the CNAME records for **sample.com** via VirusTotal, you’d make a request to the DNS‑records endpoint specifying the record type:

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/dns_records?record_type=CNAME
Authorization: Bearer secret123
```

The JSON response will contain an array of DNS‑record objects, each with its own unique `id`.  
Example (placeholder) IDs returned:

```json
["abcd1234", "efgh5678"]
```

These IDs uniquely identify the CNAME records for the queried domain.
